_comment: An exemption DEFERS a clause, it never disables one. Each carries the issue that resolves it and a date after which the gate fails anyway, mirroring tools/output_invariant_exemptions.json.

exemptions.failure_contains: input_key still carries an enumerated CHECK
exemptions.reason: dropping the CHECK in favour of registry validation is a migration and its own versioned change; the factor axis owns it
correcting a module registration changes a published factor identity, so it is versioned separately

exemptions.failure_contains: snapshot selection orders by recency alone
exemptions.reason: adding the source-priority rank is value-neutral today (every obligation resolves from one source) but changes the selection contract, so it is the datahub axis's own versioned change
